StoryMissionCfg.Story: <outline color=#000000 width=4><color=#ffffff>Fiancée kidnapped by [Time-Space Bully], I must evolve to <color=#fc0e01>{1}</c> within <color=#fc0e01>{0}</c> to save her!</c></outline>

<outline color=#000000 width=4><color=#ffffff>The幕后master finally revealed, but I'm still too weak. Unless I evolve to <color=#fc0e01>{1}</c> within <color=#fc0e01>{0}</c>, I can't save my fiancée!</c></outline>

StoryCfg.Talk: (Voice weak) Honey, I'm so scared~~~ Save me~
(Mocking) Oh, look who's here? Don't waste your effort, kid. She's mine now, hahaha~
Hahaha, what will you save her with? Those weak troops of yours?
In three days I'll offer her to our Emperor, you're welcome to attend the wedding banquet! Hahahaha~

StoryCfg.Button: Honey! Wait for me to rescue you!

StoryCfg.Talk: Oh? You're that tribe chief? In just a few days, you've progressed quite fast

StoryCfg.Button: That monster was defeated before, who are you?

StoryCfg.Talk: (Voice weak) Honey, you're still far from his match, run!
Want to run after ruining my wedding? Too naive
I'll burn my [Ancient Bloodline] to block him! Run!
Burning bloodline? Think you can block me forever like that?
At most three days, you'll be destroyed, then they'll always submit to me!
